messages:
Ellen: opened a tiny PR to refresh the hello-simplestream quickstart: unify env var names, fix the Docker run, and add a short migration note for SDK v9. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2050
Marco: on it. first glance: Node snippet uses REDWOOD_KEY in one spot. we standardized on REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Pri: good spot. also the Node text uses client.stream() which is old; replace with client.generate({ stream: true }) example.
Ellen: thanks — i'll update both. I also noticed the compose example forgot port mapping which made staging preview unreachable.
build-bot: lint: flagged code fence labeled 'js' containing TypeScript types.
Marco: i'll remove the types for the minimal example. keep the quickstart as copy-paste friendly.
Ellen: pushed updates: switched env to REDWOOD_API_KEY, updated to client.generate({stream:true}), removed TS types from the snippet, and added docker run `-p 8080:8080`.
preview-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-2050--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-simplestream — smoke test failed: service not reachable (port not exposed in Dockerfile).
Pri: can you add EXPOSE 8080 in the Dockerfile? sometimes people forget it. also add a HEALTHCHECK to reduce CI flakiness.
Ellen: done, pushed a tiny Dockerfile fix and a short note at the top: "If you're migrating from older SDKs, see the migration note for env var and streaming API changes."
Marco: CI green locally for me. one tiny wording nit: change "token" -> "API key" in the migration blurb to reduce support ambiguity.
Ellen: updated wording. plan: merge when CI stays green and tag a docs patch release after deploy. ETA ~20m.
Marco: :thumbsup:

---
Example Node snippet from PR for reviewers:
```js
// minimal streaming example
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.generate({ model: 'simplestream-small', prompt: 'stream a short greeting', stream: true })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

Action items: Ellen - merge & tag release; Marco - watch for any external 404s post-merge; Pri - add migration guide note to the v9 docs.
